new_qm9_steering_nfe.caption: Oracle MAE on alpha against forward-equivalent compute, n = 100 molecules per seed, mean +- SE over seeds 1/2/3, same base model and target set for every method. The x axis counts generative forward passes plus twice the back-propagated ones, the measured cost of a guided step here. Both axes are logarithmic: the y range spans 0.82 to 8.1 Bohr^3 and a linear axis would compress the region where the methods cross into the bottom eighth of the panel. Every method is drawn over its full measured budget ladder; best-of-N overtakes multiMFM-SS at the top of that range.
notes: one column wide (3.35 in): include at width=\columnwidth, unscaled
x LOG, y LOG -- state this in the caption
best-of-N is NOT trimmed: it wins at N = 512
DPS sample_steps extension withheld (1/N dose artifact, job 49455395)
multiMFM-SS's advantage is partly bought off this axis: 2x the regressor calls and 4-13x the PoseBusters checks of best-of-N

rerun_dna_fig4.caption: Left: Absolute error of the value estimate against the number of posterior samples, over 32 conditioning states. Both axes are logarithmic (x base 2). Error bars are the standard error over conditions. The shaded band is the reference's own Monte-Carlo spread: no curve can be resolved inside it, so the N >= 256 points sit at or below the noise floor of the comparison and must not be read as resolved. Right: Target error against forward-equivalent compute for five inference-time steering methods on the parent-disjoint L=50 DNA flow. The x axis counts generative forward passes plus 1.1 back-propagated forward passes per returned sample (the 1.1 is measured on an H200 for this code path) and is logarithmic; y is linear and anchored at zero. Error bars are the standard error over 3 repeats of 100 outputs. dMFM leads below 430 forward-equivalent NFE and Feynman-Kac above it; both regions are inside the plotted range.
notes: full text width (6.85 in): include at width=\textwidth, unscaled
x axis LOG (base 2), y axis LOG
the shaded band is the comparison's own noise floor, not a result
the SDE MC floor series is omitted from the published panel
x axis is LOG; y axis is LINEAR and includes zero
k = 1.1 is measured, not assumed (docs/nfe_accounting_audit.md)
on the published axis (backward billed at zero) the crossover is 582 instead, and dMFM appears to win at two settings rather than one
